title: [XP Planet] 3-Day Rockies Tour with Glacier View Lodge Stay
includes: Breakfast & Dinner at Glacier View Lodge
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The schedule and itinerary could be impacted by extreme weather and road conditions, while we may make necessary adjustments. We appreciate your understanding in case of any delays or changes.

If you have special needs (such as but not limited to: bed type, vegetarian options, high-chairs, etc.) please inform us at least 7 days before your trip. We will do our best to accommodate you, but there is no guarantee.
If you have a connecting flight after the tour, please ensure that your flight departs after 9:30 pm for domestic; 10:30 pm for international.

The North American Hotel Standard Room is equipped with one large bed or two standard beds. If you have a specific request for bed types, please inform us at the time of booking and we will do our best to accommodate you.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Travel in a small-group loop of just 13 guests, following a perfectly designed route from Calgary to Banff, the Icefields, Jasper, and back to CalTgary — no backtracking, only seamless scenic progression. Stay one night at the exclusive Glacier View Lodge, right in the heart of the Columbia Icefield, and experience the rare magic of sunrise and sunset after the crowds have left.

Led by top-rated local guides (98%+ Google reviews), this journey balances expert storytelling with a relaxed pace. Six handpicked photo stops, two professionally edited photos per room, and a special XP Planet souvenir gift turn every moment into a memory worth keeping — not just a trip, but an experience to bring home.
